items.quote: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names
items.claim: Moses and Aaron took men who were identified by their names
items.object: these men which are expressed by their names

items.quote: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month
items.claim: The congregation was assembled together on the first day of the second month

items.quote: and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls
items.claim: Pedigrees were declared organized by families and households, counting males twenty years old and above
items.mechanism: after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls
